questions.topic: Disorders of The Esophagus and Stomach
questions.stemEn: A child is admitted with pneumonia for the third time and has a chronic history of coughing while feeding. What should be done next?
questions.explanationAr: المصدر يختار Videofluoroscopic swallowing study لتقييم chronic aspiration، ويذكر أن recurrent respiratory infections وcough around feeding من clues المهمة.
questions.clinicalPearl: Recurrent pneumonia plus cough during feeds should trigger an aspiration evaluation.

tts.text: A child is admitted with pneumonia for the third time and has a chronic history of coughing while feeding. What should be done next? Option A. Videofluoroscopic swallowing study.

questions.topic: Disorders of The Esophagus and Stomach
questions.stemEn: A 10-year-old has difficulty swallowing solid food and needs water with every meal. There is no history of allergy. What is the most likely diagnosis?
questions.explanationAr: المصدر يختار Achalasia، لكنه يوضح أن solid-food dysphagia قد تظهر مبكرًا أيضًا في EoE. رجّح achalasia لأن history of atopy غير موجودة ولأن شرب الماء يساعد مرور الطعام.
questions.incorrectOptionsAr: EoE يبقى differential حقيقي رغم غياب atopy، لذلك لا يُحوّل مفتاح B إلى verifiedAnswer قبل مراجعة مستقلة.
questions.clinicalPearl: Early achalasia can present with solid-food dysphagia that progresses to both solids and liquids.

tts.text: A 10-year-old has difficulty swallowing solid food and needs water with every meal. There is no history of allergy. What is the most likely diagnosis? Option A. Gastroesophageal reflux disease. Option B. Achalasia. Option C. Eosinophilic esophagitis. Option D. Candida esophagitis.

questions.topic: Disorders of The Esophagus and Stomach
questions.stemEn: An 11-year-old has progressive dysphagia to solids and liquids and has lost 7 kg. What is the most appropriate initial next step?

options.text: Upper GI series / barium swallow / esophagram

questions.explanationAr: المصدر يختار esophagram/barium swallow كـinitial test، ثم يذكر أن manometry هو الأكثر حساسية ونوعية لتأكيد achalasia لاحقًا.
questions.incorrectOptionsAr: Manometry قد يؤكد التشخيص لكنه ليس أول خطوة حسب المصدر؛ CT أنسب عند الاشتباه بضغط خارجي، وendoscopy قد تأتي لاحقًا لاستبعاد pathology أخرى.
questions.clinicalPearl: Esophagram is a useful initial study; manometry confirms achalasia.

tts.text: An 11-year-old has progressive dysphagia to solids and liquids and has lost 7 kg. What is the most appropriate initial next step? Option A. Esophageal manometry. Option B. Upper endoscopy. Option C. Upper GI series / barium swallow / esophagram. Option D. Chest CT.

questions.stemEn: A patient has dysphagia and a bird's-beak appearance on barium swallow, suggesting achalasia. What test should be done next?

questions.clinicalPearl: Manometry is the confirmatory physiologic test for achalasia.

questions.topic: Disorders of The Esophagus and Stomach
questions.stemEn: A 10-year-old boy has recurrent vomiting and no improvement after two months of PPI therapy. A barium swallow image was provided. What should be done next?

options.text: Continue PPI for one more month

questions.explanationAr: المصدر يختار surgical referral، لكنه يصرّح أن الصورة قد تكون hiatal hernia أو أن exam collectors ربما وضعوا صورة خاطئة وأنها قد تمثل achalasia. لذلك السؤال لا يمكن اعتباره clean item دون الصورة الأصلية ومراجعتها.
questions.incorrectOptionsAr: الاستمرار أو تبديل العلاج الدوائي يعتمد على التشخيص الحقيقي، الذي لا يمكن حسمه من الـrecall الحالي.
questions.clinicalPearl: Do not publish an image-driven management question when the source itself questions which radiologic diagnosis was shown.

image.captionAr: الصورة الأصلية مذكورة في السؤال وتحتاج الربط قبل النشر.
image.captionEn: Original source image is required before publication.
